name: reBot Teleoperation & Vision
name_zh: reBot 具身视觉遥控与机械臂驱动
description: reBot B601-DM arm control on the reCamera: arm on the B4 board CAN bus, Wi-Fi AP hotspot, browser cockpit with touch teleoperation, hand-eye calibration, tap-to-grasp, gravity-compensation hand-guiding and recording to Parquet files. Vision is included (H.264 video, YOLO object detection on the TPU, ArUco markers); no other camera app is needed.
description_zh: reCamera 上的 reBot B601-DM 机械臂控制：机械臂接 B4 底板 CAN 总线，开机自启 Wi-Fi 热点，浏览器驾驶舱支持触屏遥控、手眼标定、点选抓取、重力补偿拖动示教与 Parquet 录制。已内置视觉（H.264 视频、TPU 运行 YOLO 物体识别、ArUco 标记识别），无需再安装其他相机应用。

items.title: Control Loop Owner (auto = default: RT executor on rebot-dm/mock, legacy otherwise; legacy = supervisor-lock loop; executor = explicit RT executor request, refusing ineligible configs and preserving DRV-F1 legacy handback on init failure)
items.title_zh: 控制循环所有者（auto = 默认：rebot-dm/mock 用实时执行器，其余用 legacy；legacy = supervisor 锁循环；executor = 显式请求实时执行器，不符合条件时拒绝启动，初始化可恢复失败时按 DRV-F1 切回 legacy 保持）

items.title: Operator PIN (4-12 digits). The cockpit asks for it for gravity mode, calibration, detection, saving poses and resetting an E-stop. Empty: armd writes a new random PIN to /userdata/rebot-teleop/operator.pin (root only) at every start
items.title_zh: 操作员 PIN（4-12 位数字）。驾驶舱里的重力补偿、标定、识别、保存点位和复位急停需要输入。留空：armd 每次启动生成新的随机 PIN，写在 /userdata/rebot-teleop/operator.pin（仅 root 可读）

items.title: AP Band (5g = 5 GHz, 2g4 = 2.4 GHz; 5 GHz falls back to 2.4 GHz channel 6 if it fails to start)
items.title_zh: 热点频段（5g = 5 GHz，2g4 = 2.4 GHz；5 GHz 启动失败时自动改用 2.4 GHz 信道 6）

items.title: AP Channel (0 = default: 44 on 5 GHz, 6 on 2.4 GHz)
items.title_zh: 热点信道（0 = 默认：5 GHz 用 44，2.4 GHz 用 6）

items.title: External Wi-Fi SSID
items.title_zh: 外部 Wi-Fi 名称 (可选)

items.title: Start the program at boot (restarts after a crash)
items.title_zh: 开机自动运行（崩溃后自动重启）

items.title: Program name (directory /userdata/rebot-apps/<name> with main.py)
items.title_zh: 程序名称（目录 /userdata/rebot-apps/<name>，内含 main.py）
